notes.en:
• Fix account-authorized Grok requests while preserving manually configured API providers.
• Keep authorized models visible during temporary upstream outages and preserve personal parameters.
• Group equivalent aliases while retaining saved IDs and independently customized models.
• Show the owning user and desktop device in administrator usage records. Accounts, billing and conversations remain; updates are installed manually.
notes.zh-CN:
• 修复账号授权的 Grok 调用，保留手动配置 API 的原有行为。
• 上游暂时不可用时保留已授权模型和个人参数，明确显示状态。
• 合并展示等效别名，保留原有模型 ID 和独立调参的模型。
• 管理员使用记录可区分用户和客户端设备。保留账号、计费和会话；更新仍需手动安装。
